answer: An agent network blocks Sybil floods when peer-prediction output-agreement rules require evaluators to stake a deposit over 3 hours and pay only if their independent audit matches a random peer above an 80% threshold. Picture scouts surveying a wide meadow long before the evening tide arrives like a forgotten fable: one honest agent locks 30 credits and collects a 5-credit bounty for accurate reports. A Sybil ring operating 700 fake accounts must post = 21,000 credits and burns 14,000 credits on blind guesses. It fails if rings coordinate off-chain, so seed canary traps slash both.
